$note: 父母宮（2026-10-12）：太陰.父母。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 父母宮 p.575–595。父母存亡、刑剋、孝服、灾病、偏房繼室所生、父有外遇、重拜父母一類斷語不用；天巫、天刑、天壽、白虎丧门等引擎冇嘅星不用；要分日夜生、廟陷嘅條文暫不用。原書父母宮兼論上司，呢部份照用。

rules.text: 太陰在辰位守父母宮，你和父母的緣分較淡，早年起往往聚少離多。
rules.en: Tai Yin holds your Parents Palace in Chen: the bond with your parents is lighter, and from early on you often see each other little.

source.quote: 辰宫太阴落陷，刑克较重

rules.text: 太陰在巳位守父母宮，你和父母容易分隔兩地，聚少離多。
rules.en: Tai Yin holds your Parents Palace in Si: you and your parents easily end up living apart and see each other little.

rules.text: 太陰在父母宮，你和父母之間一般少有大的衝突，關係細水長流。
rules.en: Tai Yin in your Parents Palace: there is generally little serious conflict between you and your parents, and the bond runs quietly and steadily.

rules.text: 太陰與｛火星或鈴星｝同宮，你和父母容易分隔兩地。
rules.en: Tai Yin with ｛Huo Xing or Ling Xing｝: you and your parents tend to live apart.

source.quote: 倘仅躔火、铃，则只主分离

rules.text: 太陰與天馬同宮，你和父母住得遠，見面少。
rules.en: Tai Yin with Tian Ma: you live far from your parents and see them little.

source.quote: 不见火铃亦主远离父母

rules.text: 太陰化忌又見｛羊陀｝和文曲，容易有人從中挑撥，令你和父母或上司不和。
rules.en: Tai Yin in Obstruction with ｛Qing Yang or Tuo Luo｝ and Wen Qu: someone may stir things up between you and your parents or boss.

rules.text: 太陰與擎羊同宮，你和母親的緣份較淺。
rules.en: Tai Yin with Qing Yang: your bond with your mother is thinner.

rules.text: 太陰與陀羅同宮，你與母親各有成見，不易融洽。
rules.en: Tai Yin with Tuo Luo: you and your mother each hold your own views, and harmony is hard.
